title: videos.json
description: The video lifecycle LEDGER (pipeline/state/videos.json) — the only writable lifecycle state (D-062). Every other lifecycle file (ideas.json status, publish.json status, produced_subjects.json) is a derived projection regenerated idempotently by pipeline/state/reconcile.mjs. One-way (ledger → derived) and forward-only (a projection never demotes). Governs `live_from` onward; earlier videos carry a closed backfill stamp.

schema_version.description: Ledger format version. Bump only with a migration.

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) this ledger was last written.

live_from.description: First video sequence the ledger GOVERNS (e.g. "020"). Records below it are backfilled history: never owed a lesson, never scheduled for analytics.

videos.description: One record per publish.json — keyed by that file's directory relative to content/ ("018-life-story" for the long, "018-life-story/short" for its Short).

subject.description: Channel-map coordinate 'branch/leaf' (mirrors docs/CHANNEL_MAP.md). Projected into produced_subjects.json; null when the video claims none.

idea_id.description: ideas.json idea this video came from. null for a bespoke video with no bank entry — the ideas projection is then a no-op.

content_type.description: Kept separate from long-form because Shorts need their own analytics baselines (creatorContentType).

status.description: Lifecycle status, same vocabulary as publish.json. Forward-only: published never demotes to draft_pending.

published_at.description: ISO date the owner published it; null until published.

lesson.description: The one obligation a machine cannot produce: the durable insight (D-061). State is EXPLICIT, never inferred from field presence.

state.description: pending = owed (the Stop hook blocks) · none = reviewed, nothing durable to write · linked = a KOS note exists (`note` = its slug).

at.description: ISO date the lesson state was settled.

note.description: KOS note slug when state=linked; "backfill" for the closed pre-live_from stamp.

analytics.description: The analytics loop's schedule + history. YouTube data is 48-72h delayed, so snapshots are dated and never overwritten.

due_at.description: ISO date the next snapshot is due (publish +7d, then +28d). null = never scheduled (backfilled history).

snapshots.description: Append-only dated metric snapshots. Item shape is intentionally open until the analytics thread lands.
